name: oldolduname
description: oldolduname is an obsolete system call that returns system information into a struct utsname with fixed-length fields of 9 characters. It is an older version of the uname system call, used in early kernel implementations.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct utsname where system information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set
